name: Spectacle Supply Scheme (free glasses)
summary: Free basic prescription glasses every two years for Queenslanders who have held a Health Care Card or other concession card for six months.
key: Free basic spectacles, once every two years.
who: Hold a Pensioner Concession Card, Health Care Card or Queensland Seniors Card in your own name for at least six months
Clinical need for spectacles as determined by your optometrist or ophthalmologist
how: Book an eye examination with an optometrist registered with SSS
Your optometrist helps complete the MASS 30 application form and submits it
catches: The card must be held continuously for six months first.

source.label: Queensland Government: Spectacles supply scheme - eligibility

evidence.quote: providing a comprehensive range of free basic spectacles

evidence.claim: Health Care Card held six months
evidence.quote: Hold, in your own name, one of the following concession cards continuously for a minimum period of six months
You are eligible to apply for new spectacles through SSS every two (2) years.
